module: Node "Pop Action Map" (once_instant). Removes an action map from the input stack (popActionMap). Input: name. The todo field points to odd behavior if several projects use the same action map.
notes: Bug: workOnce uses self.mapName, never defined in this node (it is only defined by Push Action Map); the name pin is not read, so popActionMap receives nil.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.
